nights.title: Ugly Kid Joe
nights.name: Ugly Kid Joe
nights.extract: Ugly Kid Joe is an American hard rock band from Isla Vista, California, formed in 1989. The band's name spoofs the glam metal band Pretty Boy Floyd's name.

en.who: Ugly Kid Joe is an American hard rock band from Isla Vista, California. Its name is a spoof of the glam metal band Pretty Boy Floyd.
facts: The band was formed in 1989 and comes from Isla Vista, California.
Its name spoofs the name of the glam metal band Pretty Boy Floyd.

de.who: Ugly Kid Joe ist eine amerikanische Hard-Rock-Band aus Isla Vista, Kalifornien. Ihr Name ist eine Parodie auf die Glam-Metal-Band Pretty Boy Floyd.
facts: Die Band wurde 1989 gegründet und stammt aus Isla Vista, Kalifornien.
Ihr Name parodiert den Namen der Glam-Metal-Band Pretty Boy Floyd.

tr.who: Ugly Kid Joe, Kaliforniya'nın Isla Vista kentinden bir Amerikan hard rock grubudur. Adı, glam metal grubu Pretty Boy Floyd'un adıyla dalga geçer.
facts: Grup 1989'da kuruldu ve Kaliforniya'nın Isla Vista kentinden geliyor.
Adı, glam metal grubu Pretty Boy Floyd'un adını parodi eder.
